english.title: Drive a motor vehicle otherwise than in accordance with a licence - endorsable offence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) otherwise than in accordance with a licence authorising you to drive a motor vehicle of that class
english.legislation: Contrary to section 87(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) This is the ENDORSABLE VERSION of the offence and is committed where the offender held, or could have been granted, a driving licence authorising the driving of the vehicle in question AND he / she was driving in circumstances that were not or would not have been in accordance with that licence. In any other circumstances, the offence is not liable to endorsement, an 'endorsable' Fixed Penalty Notice cannot be issued, and officers should refer to the non-endorsable version in document H9420 (CJS code RT88507).
(ii) This offence is appropriate for an offender who's licence has been revoked under the Road Traffic (New Drivers) Act 1995. However, where an offenders licence has been revoked or refused by DVLA for a medical / disability reason, the offence under section 94A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 in document H9153 (CJS code RT88139) should be considered. The penalty for the section 94A offence is endorsable and imprisonable - akin to driving whilst disqualified.
(iii) This offence wording could be used even where the offender has never held a licence to drive or where a person is disqualified by reason of age. (UNDER AGE DRIVING) .
(iv) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(v) If appropriate include the additional information in the Statement of Facts that the defendant was disqualified by reason of age.
(vi) The Fixed penalty ticket scheme may be applied.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale and:-

Discretionary disqualification and obligatory endorsement of licence - three to six points,

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
